entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I think I need to return something. I have my order number, but I'm just so confused by everything on the website. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide me with the order number so I can pull up your details?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's for a helmet.
Thank you. I have your order right here. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just... the color. It looked so different online, and now that I have it, it's not what I wanted. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just don't know what to do.
I completely understand, sometimes colors can look a bit different from screen to screen. Let me check the policy for you. I see the helmet was delivered 7 days ago.
Is that bad? I read something about 10 days, or 20 days... I don't get it.

Not at all. You have nothing to worry about. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date, especially if the item is in its original condition. Since you've confirmed the box is unopened, you are well within the window to make a return for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. So what do I do now? This is all so overwhelming.

I'll make it simple for you. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I've just sent it to the email address on your account. All you need to do is print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund immediately. We want to make sure you have gear you love, as having the right equipment is key to your safety on the road.
Okay... I think I can do that. Thank you.

You're very welcome. And since you're a VIP member with us, and to apologize for the confusion with the item's color, I've also added a $20 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that towards a new helmet, or any other gear you might need.
Wow, really? You didn't have to do that! Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a huge help.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Great. Have a wonderful day and happy riding!
